title: DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory process crash
reason: No supported fix exists. The patched brace-expansion 5.0.8 replaced its default function export with a named export, so minimatch 3.x/9.x break with `TypeError: expand is not a function`. Nine of the ten minimatch consumers in this tree still declare ^3.x, including the latest eslint, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, eslint-plugin-react and @electron/* releases. Forcing minimatch 10.x reaches 0 advisories but breaks eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, which calls minimatch as a default-exported function.
notExploitableHere: The advisory needs attacker-controlled glob patterns. Every pattern in this repository comes from our own configuration (eslint.config.js, forge config, packaging patterns), and the chain is devDependency-only so it never ships in the packaged app.
resolvesWhen: eslint, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, eslint-plugin-react and the @electron/* packages declare minimatch >=10 (or brace-expansion >=5.0.8).
